name: Clive
source:
Clive is a short visual novel about someone who's trying to survive after a breakup, but complicated by the fact that he must evacuate town.

[From [url=https://mykanthrope.itch.io/clive]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《克莱夫》是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述了一个在分手后试图生存的人的故事，但由于他必须撤离城镇，情况变得复杂。

[来自[url=https://mykanthrope.itch.io/clive]Itch.io[/url]]
